title: Find the nationality of drivers who recorded a Q3 qualifying time starting
question: Find the nationality of drivers who recorded a Q3 qualifying time starting with '1:1' in any race and also have at least one race result where they did not finish (time is NULL). Return only nationalities that appear for more than one such driver, sorted alphabetically.

prediction.sql: SELECT "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0" AS nationality FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d."XCL_041" AS "__grain_value_0", d."XCL_034" AS "__grain_value_1" FROM drivers AS d WHERE d."XCL_034" IN (SELECT q."XCL_058" FROM qualifying AS q WHERE q."XCL_064" LIKE '1:1%') AND d."XCL_034" IN (SELECT r."XCL_075" FROM results AS r WHERE r."XCL_084" IS NULL)) AS __ontology_entity_grain GROUP BY "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_1") > 1 ORDER BY "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0" ASC

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.
Lap time recorded in the second qualifying session (Q2). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q1, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q1 times.
Lap time recorded in the third qualifying session (Q3). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q2, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q2 times.

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.

arguments.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_041" AS nationality
FROM drivers AS d
WHERE d."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT q."XCL_058"
    FROM qualifying AS q
    WHERE q."XCL_064" LIKE '1:1%'
)
AND d."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT r."XCL_075"
    FROM results AS r
    WHERE r."XCL_084" IS NULL
)
GROUP BY d."XCL_041"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d."XCL_034") > 1
ORDER BY d."XCL_041" ASC

SELECT "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0" AS nationality FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d."XCL_041" AS "__grain_value_0", d."XCL_034" AS "__grain_value_1" FROM drivers AS d WHERE d."XCL_034" IN (SELECT q."XCL_058" FROM qualifying AS q WHERE q."XCL_064" LIKE '1:1%') AND d."XCL_034" IN (SELECT r."XCL_075" FROM results AS r WHERE r."XCL_084" IS NULL)) AS __ontology_entity_grain GROUP BY "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_1") > 1 ORDER BY "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0" ASC

SELECT d."XCL_041" AS nationality
FROM drivers AS d
WHERE d."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT q."XCL_058"
    FROM qualifying AS q
    WHERE q."XCL_064" LIKE '1:1%'
)
AND d."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT r."XCL_075"
    FROM results AS r
    WHERE r."XCL_084" IS NULL
)
GROUP BY d."XCL_041"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d."XCL_034") > 1
ORDER BY d."XCL_041" ASC
